summary: All four subsections cover design a process architecture within the assigned scope. Vendor descriptions and ISO APG guidance are correctly attributed and distinguished from verified evidence. Each subsection includes the required workflow elements (roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions) and an illustrative example using a hypothetical scenario. The two permitted source URLs are used appropriately and each citation is supported by the research record. No FAQ sections are present, which is correct as none are assigned. The changed paragraphs introduce no new problems, and there are no unresolved findings from the previous review. The page passes all checks.
